title: ADOPTION DAY PREVIEW
description: The pet adoption screen now lets players hear each animal's tiny greeting, see favorite foods, preview sleeping spots, and test one name before confirming.
consequence: The adoption form starts wagging first.

title: BORROWED SOFA WEEKEND
description: Neighbors can now lend furniture for a weekend trial, letting players live with a premium couch, lamp, or suspiciously emotional rug before deciding anything.
consequence: The sofa becomes a houseguest before it becomes furniture.

title: INSTANT BOND TOKEN
description: Companions now offer a paid bonding token that unlocks loyal idle poses, greeting lines, and trust animations without the usual shared quest history.

title: ACCOUNT-SAFE CALLSIGNS
description: Squadmates, pets, and favorite weapons now display moderated archetype labels in purchase previews instead of custom names or old run nicknames.
consequence: The companion introduces itself as a category.
